sections.text: One point a week: the last run of each week, the weeks ending on this run's weekday. A dash: no run that week.
sections.title: The numbers behind the lines (open findings per week)

lines: A finding is a rule Open on an asset, as STIG Manager has it now. Nothing is written to STIG Manager.
Since last week: this run against the run of 6 to 8 days ago, rule by rule. Closed is the hosts a rule is open on fewer, opened the hosts it is open on more.
A rule closed on one host and opened on another in the same week counts as neither.
A collection that was not in last week's run is "New here" and is not in the week's totals.
Fixed on the host, still Open: the STIG drift reports' last scans against this run's Open findings.
By platform: an asset counts under each platform it has a STIG of, so one with STIGs of two platforms counts in both. A finding counts under its own STIG's platform.

A STIG's platform: the first of stigman_scorecard_platforms with a pattern that matches its benchmark id (Linux rhel_*, oracle_linux_*, *ubuntu*, sles_*, *linux*; Windows ms_windows_*, windows_*, ms_sql_*, iis_*, ms_*; Network cisco_*, juniper_*, palo_alto_*, f5_*, arista_*, *router*, *switch*, *firewall*).
Other: the STIGs no platform matched - Apache_Server_2-4_UNIX_Server_STIG, VMW_Aria_Operations_8-x_Apache_STIG, VMW_vSphere_7-0_ESXi_STIG.
Compared with the run of 2026-11-06 06:02 UTC.
